summary: Iran launched a large-scale ballistic missile attack targeting King Faisal Air Base in Jordan hosting US forces, with 35-40 missiles intercepted by Jordanian air defenses. Simultaneously, IRGC forces seized a US unmanned underwater vehicle in the Strait of Hormuz and shot down a US MQ-1 drone over Bandar Abbas, while US forces reportedly struck Iranian tankers at Kharg and Jask islands. Yemeni forces conducted reprisal attacks on Saudi southern oil installations.
key_points: Iran fired an estimated 35-40 ballistic missiles, including possible Khorramshahr-3/4 with cluster munitions, from Yazd and other locations toward King Faisal Air Base in Jordan targeting US forces and aircraft. (Source: @kianmeli1/91700)
Jordanian air defenses intercepted all Iranian missiles over Amman, Azraq, Mafraq, and northern Jordan; no casualties or debris in residential areas reported. (Source: @mamlekate/104408)
IRGC seized a US Navy unmanned underwater vehicle (580cm, ~3 tons, 10-day endurance) in the Strait of Hormuz and shot down a US MQ-1 attack drone over Bandar Abbas. (Source: @VahidOnline/78275)

US forces reportedly attacked Iranian tankers at Kharg Island and Jask port for a second time; Iran warned any attack on its tankers will trigger retaliation against US bases and interests region-wide. (Source: @New_security8200/203709, @VahidOnline/78281)
Yemeni armed forces launched fresh reprisal attacks against Saudi Arabia's southern oil installations. (Source: @presstv/205987)

IDF conducted brigade-level operation in Aqraba, south of Nablus, killing a wanted Palestinian who threw Molotov cocktail and IED, using pressure cooker tactic with shoulder-launched missiles and bulldozer; detained 3 others and questioned ~60 suspects across Qabalan, Awarta, Yatma. (Source: @manniefabian/59121)
Artillery shelling reported in Lebanon at Doha Kfar Rumman and Zoutar Al-Sharqiya. (Source: @redlinkleb/41667, @redlinkleb/41703, @redlinkleb/41704)
Turkish Foreign Ministry condemned Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia and demanded immediate cessation. (Source: @N12chat/225811)

sections.executive_summary: Iran launched its largest direct missile attack since the ceasefire, firing an estimated 35-40 ballistic missiles from multiple provinces including Yazd and Lorestan toward King Faisal Air Base in Jordan targeting US forces. Jordanian air defenses intercepted all missiles over Amman, Azraq, Mafraq, and northern Jordan with no reported casualties. Concurrently, IRGC forces seized a US unmanned underwater vehicle in the Strait of Hormuz and downed a US MQ-1 drone over Bandar Abbas, while US forces reportedly struck Iranian tankers at Kharg and Jask islands for a second time. Iran warned any further attacks on its tankers will trigger retaliation against US bases and interests across the region.

points: Iran launched an estimated 35-40 ballistic missiles in a single wave from multiple locations including Yazd (Yazd Province), Khorramabad (Lorestan Province), Zanjan (Zanjan Province), and possibly Isfahan, targeting King Faisal Air Base in Jordan hosting US forces and aircraft. Some missiles displayed multi-stage or cluster munition characteristics, possibly Khorramshahr-3/4 variants launched from IRGC Aerospace Force's Al-Ghadir base. (Source: @kianmeli1/91700, @shin_persian/9605, @shin_persian/9623, @shin_persian/9621, @Faytuks_Network/6946)

IRGC Navy seized a US Navy unmanned underwater vehicle (UUV) in the Strait of Hormuz, describing it as 'spoils of war'; the UUV measures approximately 580cm in length, weighs nearly 3 tons, and can operate autonomously for up to 10 days. IRGC stated it would release footage of the captured vessel within hours. (Source: @VahidOnline/78275, @asafroz/53221, @lelotsenzura/94331)
Iranian Army air defense forces shot down a US Army MQ-1 attack drone over Bandar Abbas; IRGC also claimed downing of a US MQ-9 drone. (Source: @VahidOnline/78275, @asafroz/53221)

Iranian officials reported US forces attacked Iranian tankers at Kharg Island and Jask port for a second time; explosions reported at both locations. Ali Abdollahi, commander of Khatam al-Anbiya Central HQ, stated US warned three Iranian tankers to evacuate and threatened to target them. (Source: @New_security8200/203709, @New_security8200/203708, @asafroz/53226, @VahidOnline/78281)

Iran issued explicit warning that any attack on Iranian tankers will be met with response from Iranian armed forces targeting US bases and interests throughout the region. Majid Ibn-Reza, head of Defense Ministry, claimed Iranian forces possess capability to target US warships; Mohsen Rezaei stated an anti-ship missile was tested over a US warship for the first time, causing US vessels to flee. (Source: @VahidOnline/78281, @VahidOnline/78265)

Iranian media and analysts described the missile attack as the largest since the ceasefire and a shift from limited responses to broader responses matching escalation scale, with new equation: 'strike more, face larger retaliation.' (Source: @kianmeli1/91697, @rasedal3ado138e/389970)

IDF conducted brigade-level operation in Aqraba, south of Nablus in northern West Bank, killing wanted Palestinian Abd al-Karim Muhammad Salem Khader after he attacked forces with Molotov cocktail and improvised bomb; troops used 'pressure cooker' tactic with shoulder-launched missiles and bulldozer demolition; Nahal Brigade Reconnaissance Unit killed him after he brandished knife; body seized by Israeli forces. (Source: @manniefabian/59121)

IDF detained three Palestinians involved in terror activity and questioned approximately 60 other wanted suspects during overnight operations in Qabalan, Awarta, and Yatma villages. (Source: @manniefabian/59121)
IDF eliminated a terrorist who attempted to attack forces in Samaria and arrested four additional suspects in a brigade-level operation. (Source: @idf_telegram/25088)
Israeli footage documented cluster missiles fired toward Jordan during Iranian attack. (Source: @pkpoi/143891)
Interceptions visible across Israel were confirmed to be occurring in Jordanian airspace following Iranian missile fire. (Source: @amitsegal/64783)

UK Foreign Minister Ed Miliband announced import ban on goods from 'illegal settlements in occupied territories' in Judea and Samaria, alleging 'ethnic cleansing of Palestinians in the West Bank.' (Source: @lelotsenzura/94328)

IDF operation in Aqraba, south of Nablus: troops raided building housing wanted Palestinian Abd al-Karim Muhammad Salem Khader, who threw Molotov cocktail and IED at forces; soldiers surrounded building, employed 'pressure cooker' tactic with escalating fire, used shoulder-launched missiles and bulldozer to demolish part of structure; Nahal Brigade Reconnaissance Unit killed Khader after he brandished knife; body seized; Palestinian WAFA confirms body taken by Israeli forces. (Source: @manniefabian/59121)

Additional IDF operations overnight in villages of Qabalan, Awarta, and Yatma resulted in detention of three Palestinians involved in terror activity and questioning of approximately 60 other wanted suspects. (Source: @manniefabian/59121)
IDF brigade operation in Samaria eliminated terrorist attempting attack against forces and arrested four additional suspects. (Source: @idf_telegram/25088)
Artillery shelling reported at Doha Kfar Rumman in southern Lebanon. (Source: @redlinkleb/41667)
Artillery shelling reported at Zoutar Al-Sharqiya in southern Lebanon, with two separate reports. (Source: @redlinkleb/41703, @redlinkleb/41704)
Iranian missiles were tracked from South Syria during the attack on Jordan, indicating possible launch or transit corridor through Syrian airspace. (Source: @mamlekate/104408)

Missile launches reported from Iranian provinces including Yazd, Lorestan (Khorramabad), and Zanjan, with no explicit mention of launches from Syrian or Iraqi territory in the provided messages. (Source: @shin_persian/9605, @shin_persian/9623, @shin_persian/9621)

Jordanian air defenses intercepted all Iranian ballistic missiles over Amman, Azraq, Mafraq, and northern Jordan; Jordanian Air Force conducted dense fighter flights over Mafraq and Azraq 10-15 minutes before attacks; Jordanian armed forces (ground air defense and air force) placed on full alert nationwide. (Source: @mamlekate/104408)
Yemeni armed forces launched fresh reprisal attacks against Saudi Arabia's southern oil installations. (Source: @presstv/205987)
Turkish Foreign Ministry condemned Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia and called for immediate cessation of operations. (Source: @N12chat/225811)
Jordanian population reportedly supported Iranian attack by filming and locating 'criminals' in Jordan, per Iraqi channel commentary. (Source: @naya_foriraq/89794)

sections.threat_assessment: Iran has demonstrated a significant escalation in both scale and directness of its military posture, conducting its largest missile barrage since the ceasefire directly targeting a US-hosting base in Jordan while simultaneously seizing a US naval drone in the Strait of Hormuz and downing a US reconnaissance drone over its territory. The coordinated multi-axis pressure — missile strikes, naval seizure, air defense engagement, and explicit threats to retaliate against US bases for any tanker attacks — signals a shift toward broader confrontation. The US response of striking Iranian tankers at Kharg and Jask creates a dangerous action-reaction cycle. Jordan's successful interception of 35-40 missiles with zero casualties demonstrates effective air defense integration but also confirms Jordan as a forward battleground. Yemeni attacks on Saudi oil infrastructure and Turkish condemnation indicate regional spillover risk. IDF West Bank operations continue at high tempo with heavy engineering and fire support, suggesting sustained counter-terrorism campaign.
sections.regional_response: Jordan activated full nationwide air defense and air force alert, successfully intercepting a massive missile wave with no reported casualties, demonstrating robust defensive capability and willingness to defend its airspace against Iranian projectiles targeting US assets on its soil. Turkey diplomatically condemned Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, signaling Ankara's concern over Red Sea energy security. The UK imposed import restrictions on settlement goods citing 'ethnic cleansing' allegations, adding diplomatic pressure on Israel. Iraqi commentary praised Jordanian public support for the Iranian attack, revealing complex Arab street dynamics. Saudi Arabia faces continued Houthi pressure on oil infrastructure despite Turkish calls for cessation. The US maintains military presence at King Faisal Air Base and naval assets in Hormuz despite Iranian seizures and missile threats, indicating commitment to regional posture.
sections.intelligence_notes: The Iranian missile attack featured possible cluster munition warheads (Khorramshahr-3/4 variants) launched from multiple inland provinces (Yazd, Lorestan, Zanjan), suggesting dispersed launch architecture and advanced payloads designed to overwhelm point defenses. The 120-second delayed reporting from Iranian launch sites via FromIran network indicates operational security awareness. IRGC's seizure of a 580cm/3-ton UUV with 10-day endurance in Hormuz represents a significant intelligence coup — exploitation could reveal US undersea surveillance patterns. Simultaneous MQ-1 shootdown over Bandar Abbas suggests layered air defense readiness. US tanker strikes at Kharg/Jask appear calibrated to pressure Iranian oil exports without triggering full conflict, but Iran's explicit linkage of tanker security to US base targeting creates a clear red line. IDF 'pressure cooker' tactic with bulldozers and shoulder-launched missiles in dense West Bank urban areas indicates high-intensity counter-insurgency doctrine. The convergence of Iranian missile launches, US naval strikes, Yemeni-Saudi attacks, and Israeli West Bank operations within hours suggests a region-wide escalation pulse rather than isolated incidents.
